title: Hire your first help
tagline: Flexible workers or a first employee, insured and paid correctly, without the paperwork.
trigger: Invoice income keeps growing, more clients than one person can serve, or paying subcontractors.

steps.title: Can the business carry a salary?
steps.description: A cash-flow forecast with and without a hire, from your own invoice history.
steps.why: Based on the invoices paid into your account. Nothing is shared.

win.customer: Hire on numbers, not on gut feeling

steps.result: Forecast ready: invoice income grew {invoice_growth_pct}% to about €{invoice_monthly} a month. A part-time hire fits within your cash flow (illustrative).

steps.title: Start with flexible workers
steps.description: Find and pay flexi-jobbers or students for peak weeks through NOWJOBS, contracts and declarations included.
steps.why: NOWJOBS only receives your company name and what help you need, never your bank data.

win.customer: Help next week, no long commitment
win.partner: A new employer on the platform

steps.result: NOWJOBS account ready: your first shift is posted and the contract is generated.

steps.title: Payroll and HR admin
steps.description: Human Capital Solutions: payroll, the first-employee declarations and a social secretariat in one flow.
steps.why: The first hire comes with registrations you only do once; we guide you through them.
steps.result: Payroll set up. The declarations for your first employee are prepared for your signature.

steps.title: Occupational accident insurance
steps.description: Compulsory for employers in Belgium: it covers accidents at work and on the way to work.
steps.why: Must be in place before the first working day.
steps.result: Occupational accident insurance active from the first working day.

steps.title: Protect and reward your team
steps.description: The Team Protect Plan and a group pension (Team Benefit Plan) to attract and keep good people.
steps.why: Small employers compete with large ones on benefits.

win.customer: An attractive offer to a first employee

steps.result: Team Protect Plan ready to start with your first employee.
